name: Premier Quality Starch Public Company Limited
summary: Premier Quality Starch Public Company Limited (PQS.BK) specializes in the global manufacture and sale of starch, primarily tapioca starch, which is processed from fresh root crops. The company supplies these starch products to a wide range of clients across both the food ingredient and various non-food sectors worldwide. In addition to its core starch operations, PQS.BK generates its own electricity through the use of biogas, which is sustainably produced from organic waste materials found in its wastewater and cassava pulp byproducts. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Mukdahan, Thailand.
